pages.title: Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer
pages.text: Circuits laid out in four dimensions, then folded flat so that I can hold them. Signals travel short paths through the hidden dimension, so the circuit computes faster than its visible wiring allows. It is perfectly flat and somehow deep.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Quantum Lithographer, I exposed a Hyperdimensional Wafer through Quantum-Dot Photoresist and let the light follow the fourth dimension. The circuit folded itself into the hidden face.
